Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Karyotype analysis requested

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis

METHODOLOGY
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured and harvested according to standard protocols. Metaphase chromosomes were G-banded using trypsin-Giemsa staining. A minimum of 20 cells were analysed at 550 band resolution.

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XY

INTERPRETATION
Normal male chromosome complement. No numerical or structural chromosomal abnormalities detected on G-banded analysis.

COMMENT
This result supersedes previous PCR analysis report.
